meta.name: to-tickets
meta.description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker — edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把计划或讨论拆成可追踪的工单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需将需求或讨论转化为可执行的工单
copy.tagline_en: Break plans or discussions into trackable tickets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn requirements or discussions into actionable tickets

howto.what: 把计划、规范或当前对话拆成一串垂直切片 tickets，每个标注阻塞它的其他 tickets；先让用户确认再发布到配置好的追踪器（本地文件或真实 issue 平台）。
howto.when: 当用户要求把计划、规范或当前对话拆成一组带依赖关系的 tickets 并发布到追踪器时触发；如果追踪器未配置，需要先运行 /setup-matt-pocock-skills。

say.text: 把当前计划拆成 tickets 发布到本地文件
say.note: 先列出分割方案供你确认

say.text: 把这段对话拆成 tickets，标出谁阻塞谁
把这个 spec 拆成垂直切片 tickets，发到 GitHub
say.note: 每个 ticket 成为一条 issue

howto.what_en: Breaks a plan, spec, or the conversation into vertical-slice tickets, each with its blocking edges; confirms the breakdown with the user, then publishes to the configured tracker (local files or a real issue platform).
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to break a plan, spec, or the conversation into dependent tickets and publish them to the tracker; if the tracker isn't configured, it prompts to run /setup-matt-pocock-skills first.

say_en.text: Break this plan into tickets and publish to local files.
Break this conversation into tickets and mark which block which.
Break this spec into vertical-slice tickets and post to GitHub.
